items.question: Which support principle and tetrad must be installed within the ritual vessel?
premises: Ananta, designated as the support, is to be included.
A tetrad beginning with dharma is to be included.
Both are placed together within the ritual vessel.
items.inference: The ritual installation requires Ananta as support along with the tetrad beginning with dharma.
uncertainties: The specific members of the dharmādya catuṣṭaya are not enumerated in this verse.
items.plain_english: And one should place Ananta, called the support, and the tetrad beginning with dharma.
